abstract: Data harmonisation of data collected for D3.3 of task 3.3 comprising the 4 case study regions Danube - Black Sea, Elbe – North Sea, Guadalquivir – Atlantic Ocean and Po – Adriatic Sea
description: Data collected for D3.3 of task 3.3 comprising the 4 case study regions Danube - Black Sea, Elbe – North Sea, Guadalquivir – Atlantic Ocean and Po – Adriatic Sea was harmonised for standardized data template. SiteIDs and SampleIDs were generated. Names of parameters were harmonised. Data was transformed to uniform units. Biodiversity data of low taxonomic was excluded. Taxonomic names were harmonised. IDs from WoRMS (https://www.marinespecies.org/index.php) and freshwaterecology.info were added.
name: T3.3: Harmonise source data
